Crispy smashed potatoes

Recipe below ⬇️

INGREDIENTS:
- 500g baby potatoes
- 3 tbsp olive oil
- ½ tsp smoked paprika
- ½ tsp salt
- 1 tsp garlic powder

METHOD:
- Boil the potatoes until tender, about 15 minutes.
- Smash each one flat on a lined tray.
- Drizzle with the oil and sprinkle with the spices.
- Roast at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.

#potatoes #sidedish #crispy
